'''Zakuul News Bulletin''' was the state-controlled news organ of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] that transmitted the official propaganda of the Empire.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zakuul News Bulletin is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in the frequent letters that the player received through the expansion.
